aggregations.computedFrom: Per-case CheckScore.measurements for one check in one Run.
aggregations.consumers: Check rows, comparison deltas, and agent-readable run summaries.

fields.name: sum
fields.summary: Total of all numeric measurement values included in this aggregate.

fields.name: count
fields.summary: Number of evaluated cases that emitted this measurement.

fields.name: average
fields.summary: Rounded sum divided by count.

aggregations.name: Measurement Aggregate
aggregations.summary: Rolls one measurement key into sum, count, and average for a check.

aggregations.computedFrom: Per-case CheckScore.performanceScore, measurements, and optional judgments for one outcome check.
aggregations.consumers: Check tables, performance summaries, and Run comparisons.

fields.name: segmentation
fields.summary: For segmentation checks, pooled per-class pixel counts and dataset meanIou from successful leaf evidence; distinct from equal-weight case means.

fields.name: labelSet
fields.summary: For labelSet and classification checks: subset accuracy, mean case F1, micro and macro precision/recall/F1, per-class support and counts, and label accuracy/Hamming loss with fixed classes. Pooled from successfully scored cases; failed cases are counted separately.

fields.name: keypoints
fields.summary: Versioned dataset-pooled pose AP/AR, detector-selected F1@mOKS, per-class counts, resolved policy and coverage. Confidence is optimized on the evaluation Dataset; incomplete metrics are unavailable.

fields.name: performanceScore
fields.summary: Equal-weight average of normalized case performance across evaluated cases.

fields.name: measurements
fields.summary: Measurement aggregates keyed by MeasurementKey.

fields.name: judgment
fields.summary: Optional passed, failed, near-miss, material-miss, total, and pass-rate policy summary when a pass rule exists.

fields.name: evaluatedCount
fields.summary: Cases where the check applied and was evaluated; the denominator basis.

fields.name: notApplicableCount
fields.summary: Cases recorded as not applicable and excluded from every denominator.

aggregations.name: Metric Aggregate
aggregations.summary: Summarizes one semantic check across all evaluated cases in one Run.

aggregations.computedFrom: Per-case metric judgments and applicability statuses grouped by case slice.
aggregations.consumers: Slice-by-metric pass-rate matrices with row and column totals.

fields.name: rows
fields.summary: One row per case slice with a judgment cell for every pass-rule metric.

fields.name: columns
fields.summary: Pass-rule metrics rendered as matrix columns.

fields.name: columnTotals
fields.summary: Per-metric counts across every case, counted exactly once.

fields.name: grandTotal
fields.summary: Overall passed, failed, evaluated, and not-applicable counts.

aggregations.name: Judgment Matrix
aggregations.summary: Deterministic slice-by-metric pass rates computed from explicit passed/evaluated counts.

aggregations.computedFrom: Runner runtime metrics emitted for every case execution in one Run.
aggregations.consumers: Runtime metric tables, tradeoff summaries, and operational checks.

fields.name: averageLatencyMs
fields.summary: Average of runtime latencyMs values that were present.

fields.name: totalCreditCost
fields.summary: Sum of reported creditCost values.

fields.name: timeoutRate
fields.summary: Timed-out executions divided by total executions.

fields.name: failureRate
fields.summary: Executions with runtime errors divided by total executions.

aggregations.name: Runtime Aggregate
aggregations.summary: Summarizes latency, cost, timeout, and failure behavior for one Run.

aggregations.computedFrom: Check aggregates and runtime aggregate for one completed Run.
aggregations.consumers: Run hero cards, dashboards, generated artifacts, and comparison reads.

fields.name: checkPerformance
fields.summary: Check aggregates keyed by check id.

fields.name: runtime

aggregations.name: Run Summary

primaryPerformance.normalization: 1 within budget, otherwise budget divided by observed duration.

evaluators.passCondition: Can be judged with an explicit metric passRule; the suggested rule requires F1 >= 1.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Uses mAP@50 directly as a normalized 0-1 performance score.

evaluators.summary: Use for Roboflow inference predictions with class, center x/y, width, height, and optional richer geometry.

examples.note: Boolean values must match exactly.
A false/true mismatch fails.

evaluators.name: Boolean
evaluators.passCondition: Can be judged with an explicit metric passRule; the suggested rule requires exactMatch == 1.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Uses exactMatch directly as a binary 0-1 performance score.
primaryPerformance.summary: Performance is 1 for an exact boolean match and 0 otherwise.

evaluators.summary: Use for yes/no metrics such as has defect, contains text, or field present.

examples.note: Whitespace and casing are normalized before comparison.
Different labels fail.

evaluators.name: Label
evaluators.passCondition: Can be judged with an explicit metric passRule; the suggested rule requires exactMatch == 1.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Uses normalized exactMatch directly as a binary 0-1 performance score.
primaryPerformance.summary: Performance is 1 for a normalized label match and 0 otherwise.

evaluators.summary: Use for labels, classes, routing decisions, extracted names, and enum-like answers.

examples.note: Order does not matter; identical class sets are an exact match.
Missing dog gives F1 0.666667 as partial performance, but exactMatch is 0 so the suggested rule fails.

evaluators.name: Label Set
evaluators.passCondition: Can be judged with an explicit metric passRule; the suggested rule requires exactMatch == 1. An f1 threshold is the partial-credit alternative.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Uses per-case set F1 = 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN) directly; two explicitly empty sets score 1.
primaryPerformance.summary: Matches exactMatch for single-label cases and gives partial credit for multi-label overlap.

evaluators.summary: Use for class or tag sets. A single class is a singleton set; class names are exact identifiers after trimming. Optional fixed classes enable true negatives, label accuracy, and Hamming loss.

examples.note: A single-label Roboflow response contributes only its top class, not every scored candidate.
A multi-label Roboflow response contributes its predicted_classes decision; missing dog gives F1 0.666667 and fails exact match.

evaluators.name: Classification
evaluators.passCondition: Can be judged with an explicit metric passRule; the suggested rule requires exactMatch == 1. An f1 threshold is the partial-credit alternative.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Uses per-case set F1 = 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN) directly; two explicitly empty sets score 1.
primaryPerformance.summary: Matches exactMatch for single-label cases and gives partial credit for multi-label overlap.

evaluators.summary: Preset for labelSet@1 that also reads Roboflow single-label (top) and multi-label (predicted_classes) classification responses. Ground truth is one class or a class set.

examples.note: Counts are exact-match today.
Any count difference fails when the suggested exact-count rule is explicitly configured, while retaining all delta measurements.

evaluators.name: Count
evaluators.passCondition: Can be judged with an explicit metric passRule; the suggested rule requires absoluteDelta <= 0.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Uses max(0, 1 - absoluteRelativeDelta), with exact zero-to-zero scoring 1 and nonzero actual against zero ground truth scoring 0.
primaryPerformance.summary: Higher performance means a smaller count error relative to ground truth.

evaluators.summary: Use for object counts, field counts, detected issue counts, or extracted item totals.

examples.note: Numeric values can pass when a metric passRule accepts the emitted absolute delta.
Values outside the metric passRule fail and still record the complete delta measurement set.

evaluators.name: Numeric
evaluators.passCondition: Can be judged with an explicit metric passRule; the suggested rule requires absoluteDelta <= 0.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Uses max(0, 1 - absoluteRelativeDelta), with exact zero-to-zero scoring 1 and nonzero actual against zero ground truth scoring 0.
primaryPerformance.summary: Higher performance means a smaller numeric error relative to ground truth.

evaluators.summary: Use for scores, distances, measurements, confidences, and numeric extracted values.

examples.note: Roboflow inference predictions use center x/y plus width/height; a class-matched prediction with IoU >= 0.5 is a true positive.
A class mismatch fails when the suggested perfect-F1 acceptance rule is explicitly configured.

evaluators.name: Object Detection
evaluators.passCondition: Can be judged with an explicit metric passRule; the suggested rule requires F1 >= 1.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Uses mAP@50 directly as a normalized 0-1 performance score.
primaryPerformance.summary: Higher performance means stronger class-aware detection at IoU 0.5.

evaluators.summary: Compatibility preset for positionedObjects@1 using Roboflow inference detection geometry.

examples.note: Two fragmented Roboflow predictions project onto [60,110] and [105,140]; merged they cover the ground-truth span [60,140] exactly, so coverage IoU is 1. The y/height/class/confidence fields are ignored on the horizontal axis.
A prediction projecting onto [380,420] never overlaps the ground-truth span [60,140], so coverage IoU is 0 and the suggested rule fails.

evaluators.name: Interval Coverage
evaluators.passCondition: Can be judged with an explicit metric passRule; the suggested rule requires coverageIou >= 0.8.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Uses coverage IoU of merged intervals directly as a normalized 0-1 performance score.
primaryPerformance.summary: Higher performance means the merged predicted span covers the ground-truth span more completely on the configured axis.

evaluators.summary: Use for metrics where only one axis of position/size matters (cracks, seams, weld beads); boxes are projected onto the axis and merged before comparison.

examples.note: Overlapping instances union to the same four corrosion pixels as one class mask; mIoU is 1.
Two correct, two extra and two missed pixels give IoU 2/6 and pixel Dice 0.5.

evaluators.name: Segmentation
evaluators.passCondition: Only an explicit passRule applies judgment; suggested meanIou >= 0.8.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Macro mean of per-class pixel IoUs, excluding zero-union classes; 1 when all selected classes are absent on both sides.
primaryPerformance.summary: Higher means better class-mask coverage, independent of instance splitting.

evaluators.summary: Compares predicted and ground-truth masks by class. Accepts Inference points, COCO RLE, and grayscale class-ID PNG responses. Unions instances by class; excludes background by default. Select classes and backgroundClass in evaluator.config. Does not measure instance identity or mask AP.

evaluators.name: Keypoints
evaluators.summary: COCO-style pose AP/AR plus dataset F1@mOKS at detector-optimal confidence. Configure each class skeleton; default sigmas are 1/K. Missing predicted points contribute zero. Bind the full image/predictions envelope, not just predictions.
evaluators.passCondition: Only an explicit case pass rule produces judgment; dataset metrics do not produce a Run verdict.

primaryPerformance.normalization: Single-image AP in [0,1]; empty-to-empty diagnostic performance is 1 without fabricating AP.
primaryPerformance.summary: Case diagnostic only. Dataset AP/AR and F1@mOKS are separately pooled in CheckAggregate.keypoints.

examples.note: A perfect pose passes the explicitly selected AP rule; object confidence ranks instances.
An annotated occluded point still matters. An omitted prediction contributes zero, not an ignored GT point.

measurements.aggregation: Sum, count and average across evaluated cases; duration sum is not Run wall-clock time.
measurements.summary: Zero within budget; positive milliseconds above the Spec budget.

measurements.name: Latency budget score
measurements.interpretation: One within budget; budget divided by observed duration otherwise.
measurements.aggregation: Sum, count and average across evaluated cases; duration sum is not Run wall-clock time.
measurements.summary: One within budget; budget divided by observed duration otherwise.

measurements.name: Pose AP
measurements.aggregation: Case mean only; authoritative dataset pose metrics are pooled separately in CheckAggregate.keypoints.
measurements.summary: Single-image COCO-style pose diagnostic; unavailable without eligible ground truth.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. Never interpret the mean of image AP as dataset AP.

measurements.name: Pose AP50
measurements.aggregation: Case mean only; authoritative dataset pose metrics are pooled separately in CheckAggregate.keypoints.
measurements.summary: Single-image COCO-style pose diagnostic; unavailable without eligible ground truth.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. Never interpret the mean of image AP as dataset AP.

measurements.name: Pose AP75
measurements.aggregation: Case mean only; authoritative dataset pose metrics are pooled separately in CheckAggregate.keypoints.
measurements.summary: Single-image COCO-style pose diagnostic; unavailable without eligible ground truth.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. Never interpret the mean of image AP as dataset AP.

measurements.name: Pose AR
measurements.aggregation: Case mean only; authoritative dataset pose metrics are pooled separately in CheckAggregate.keypoints.
measurements.summary: Single-image COCO-style pose diagnostic; unavailable without eligible ground truth.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. Never interpret the mean of image AP as dataset AP.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average across evaluated cases for the same check in one Run.
measurements.interpretation: Positive means actual is above expected; negative means actual is below expected.
measurements.name: Signed Delta
measurements.summary: Actual minus expected for count and numeric metrics.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average absolute error across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Lower is better. Zero means actual exactly matched expected.
measurements.name: Absolute Delta
measurements.summary: Magnitude of the count or numeric miss, ignoring direction.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average relative error across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Positive means over-prediction relative to expected; negative means under-prediction.
measurements.name: Relative Delta
measurements.summary: Signed delta divided by expected for count and numeric metrics.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average relative error magnitude across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Lower is better. Useful for tolerance pass rules such as <= 0.05.
measurements.name: Absolute Relative Delta
measurements.summary: Magnitude of relative error for count and numeric metrics.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average exact-match rate across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. One means the expected and actual semantic values matched.
measurements.name: Exact Match
measurements.summary: One when a boolean or label matched, or when a predicted class set equals ground truth; otherwise zero.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average mAP@50 across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. One means all expected detections were matched at IoU >= 0.5.
measurements.name: mAP@50
measurements.summary: Mean average precision at a 0.5 IoU threshold for positioned object metrics.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average precision across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. Drops when predictions include extra unmatched detections or classes.
measurements.name: Precision
measurements.summary: True positives divided by true positives plus false positives.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average recall across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. Drops when expected detections or classes are missed.
measurements.name: Recall
measurements.summary: True positives divided by true positives plus false negatives.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average F1 across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. Balances precision and recall into one detection or class-set score.
measurements.name: F1
measurements.summary: 2TP / (2TP + FP + FN) for positioned objects or class sets; the case mean is not micro or macro F1.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average true positives across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Higher usually means more correct matches, but compare with false positives and false negatives.
measurements.name: True Positive Count
measurements.summary: Number of expected semantic items matched by actual semantic items.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average false positives across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Lower is better. Counts extra predictions that did not match expected detections.
measurements.name: False Positive Count
measurements.summary: Number of actual semantic items that did not match expected semantic items.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average false negatives across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Lower is better. Counts expected detections the workflow missed.
measurements.name: False Negative Count
measurements.summary: Number of expected semantic items that were not matched by actual semantic items.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average true negatives across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Useful for binary classification context; compare with dataset slice composition before optimizing.
measurements.name: True Negative Count
measurements.summary: Expected false boolean values predicted false, or configured vocabulary classes correctly absent from both class sets.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average coverage IoU across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. One means the merged predicted and ground-truth intervals cover exactly the same span on the axis.
measurements.name: Coverage IoU
measurements.summary: Intersection over union of the merged predicted and ground-truth intervals on the configured axis.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average coverage precision across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. Drops when predicted coverage extends beyond the ground-truth span on the axis.
measurements.name: Coverage Precision
measurements.summary: Share of the merged predicted interval length that overlaps the ground-truth intervals.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average coverage recall across evaluated cases.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better. Drops when parts of the ground-truth extent are missed by predicted coverage.
measurements.name: Coverage Recall
measurements.summary: Share of the merged ground-truth interval length that overlaps the predicted intervals.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average absolute center error across matched interval pairs.
measurements.interpretation: Lower is better. Zero means matched predicted intervals share the same axis center as ground truth.
measurements.name: Mean Absolute Center Delta
measurements.summary: Average absolute difference in axis center between greedily matched predicted and ground-truth intervals.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average absolute size error across matched interval pairs.
measurements.interpretation: Lower is better. Zero means matched predicted intervals share the same axis size as ground truth.
measurements.name: Mean Absolute Size Delta
measurements.summary: Average absolute difference in axis size between greedily matched predicted and ground-truth intervals.

measurements.aggregation: Equal-weight mean across cases; pooled dataset mIoU is separately available at CheckAggregate.segmentation.meanIou.
measurements.interpretation: Macro mean of IoU over classes with nonzero union. Empty comparisons score 1.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average across evaluated cases; CheckAggregate.labelSet.labelAccuracy pools every class decision.
measurements.interpretation: Higher is better, but sparse labels inflate it: missing one of 100 classes still scores 0.99. Do not use it as the primary score.
measurements.name: Label Accuracy
measurements.summary: Correct per-class decisions (TP + TN) divided by the configured vocabulary size; emitted only with fixed classes.

measurements.aggregation: sum, count, and average across evaluated cases; CheckAggregate.labelSet.hammingLoss pools every class decision.
measurements.interpretation: Lower is better. Equals 1 - labelAccuracy for the same vocabulary.
measurements.name: Hamming Loss
measurements.summary: Wrong per-class decisions (FP + FN) divided by the configured vocabulary size; emitted only with fixed classes.
